title: 2026 MCL Fall T20 • MCL Elite • Quarter Final
caption: A heartbreaking end to a thrilling quarterfinal battle that went down to the very last over. Having remained unbeaten in the entire tournament, Sent in to bat, the Strikers faced stiff early resistance before Yasith Perera ignited the innings with a sensational 60 off just 25 balls. Supported by gritty stands with Gurjeet Sandhu and Prabakaran Jayabalan, Perera lifted us to a fighting 123. Defending a modest total, our bowlers refused to back down. Early breakthroughs set the tone before Perera returned with the ball (3/17), tearing through the middle order to leave Mumbai reeling at 99/8. Backed by disciplined spells from Waqas Akhtar (2/15) and Riken Patel (2/30), the Strikers pushed the opposition to the absolute brink, falling short by just a single wicket in a final-over heartbreaker.

title: 2026 Summer T20 • Saturday • Gold Division • Final
caption: A tough finish in the Gold Division Final despite strong stretches of disciplined cricket. Going into the finals with only one loss in 11 league games and total domination in the playoff games. Bowling first, the Strikers struck immediately in the opening over and kept the pressure on through the middle overs. Gurmeet Dadlani’s fiery spell (3/37) and tight bowling from Amit Kumar (2/20) and Asif Mohammed (1/19) had NJ Panthers on the ropes at 116/7 before a late surge pushed their total to 146/7. Our chase started in commanding fashion, with openers Prabhjot Singh (28) and Prabakaran Jayabalan (28) racing to an effortless 45-run stand. We remained firmly in the hunt at 83/3 before a sudden middle-order collapse halted our momentum, leaving us short at 103 in a finals run we can still be proud of.

title: 2025 USCL Summer T-20 • Qualifier
caption: A frustrating morning in the Qualifier after a dominant start slipped away. Asked to bat first, the Strikers looked in complete control as openers Prabhjot Singh (28) and captain Prabakaran Jayabalan (29) anchored a crisp start, propelling the team to a commanding 77/2. Unfortunately, a sudden collapse against tight middle-over bowling saw us lose our last eight wickets for just 9 runs, leaving our bowlers only 86 to defend. Despite the low target, the Strikers came out fighting. Asif Mohammed struck in the very first over, and Santosh Lalan’s tidy double-strike (2/21) kept the pressure alive. However, without enough runs on the board, Nalwa eventually chased down the target in the 13th over.

title: 2024 USCL Summer T-20 • Final
caption: A valiant effort in the Summer T20 Final that fell just short of the trophy. Winning the toss and electing to bowl, the Strikers started brilliantly with two early wickets. After United Cricket Club mounted a mid-innings recovery, Gurmeet Dadlani (3/18) sparked a massive turnaround—triggering a 5-wicket collapse for just 5 runs alongside steady spells from Santosh Lalan (2/21) and Anbumani Mailathipathy (2/23) to restrict them to 140. In the chase, opener Prabakaran Jayabalan anchored the innings with a courageous 42 off 57 balls, building a promising partnership with Mandeep Singh (12) to keep us in contention. However, steady wickets at the other end halted our momentum at 95, capping off a hard-fought runner-up campaign.
